name: GCP
certifications: Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer

beginner.summary: No cloud experience assumed. Participants learn Google Cloud's resource hierarchy, IAM, compute, storage, networking, databases, serverless and monitoring, and deploy a small web application.
prerequisites: Basic computer and networking knowledge (IP address, DNS, web browser)
A Google Cloud project or trainer-provided sandbox with a budget alert
outcomes: Explain cloud computing, Google Cloud regions and zones and the shared responsibility model
Organise resources in organisations, folders and projects and control access with IAM
Deploy and secure Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC networks and Cloud SQL
Deploy, monitor and cost-control a simple web application on Google Cloud

days.topic: Cloud Computing Concepts and Google Cloud Global Infrastructure
subtopics: What cloud computing is: on-demand, pay-as-you-go
Google Cloud regions, zones and the private network
Creating a project and enabling billing
Console, Cloud Shell and gcloud CLI
days.lab_task: Set up a project for training: create a 10 USD budget with an email alert, open Cloud Shell, enable the Compute Engine API and choose a region with a written reason.
days.deliverable: Screenshots of the budget and Cloud Shell session, plus a region choice note
checks: A 10 USD budget with an alert exists
Run gcloud config list in Cloud Shell
Ask: who patches the OS of a Compute Engine VM?
Participant answers the customer, citing the shared responsibility model
objectives: Explain cloud service and deployment models
Protect a new project with a budget

days.topic: Resource Hierarchy, Projects and IAM
subtopics: IAM principals: users, groups, service accounts
Why to avoid service account keys
days.lab_task: Give a developer group the Viewer role on the project and Storage Object Viewer on one bucket, and prove a developer cannot delete a VM.
days.deliverable: IAM bindings screenshot and the denied delete attempt
checks: Explain why a basic Owner role is risky
Participant explains the breadth of basic roles

days.topic: Compute Engine Virtual Machines
subtopics: SSH with OS Login and IAP
days.lab_task: Create a Debian VM with a startup script that installs a web server, connect over IAP with no public SSH port, and show the web page.
days.deliverable: VM details, firewall rules and the web page
checks: Browse to the VM external IP on port 80
SSH to the external IP on port 22 from the internet
objectives: Create and connect to VMs securely

days.topic: Persistent Disks, Snapshots and Images
subtopics: Encryption with Google and customer keys
days.lab_task: Attach a disk, write a test file, snapshot it on a schedule, delete the disk, restore it from the snapshot, and build a custom image of the web server.
days.deliverable: Command log, restored file contents and a VM started from the custom image
checks: Read the test file on the restored disk
Start a VM from the custom image

days.topic: Cloud Storage
days.lab_task: Create a versioned bucket with public access prevention, overwrite and restore a file, add a lifecycle rule, and share one object with a 15-minute signed URL.
days.deliverable: Bucket settings, version history and signed URL test
checks: Open the object without a signed URL
Open the signed URL within 15 minutes
objectives: Protect data with versioning and lifecycle rules

days.topic: VPC Networks, Subnets and Firewall Rules
subtopics: Network tags and service accounts as targets
days.lab_task: Build a custom VPC with web and app subnets in two regions, firewall rules using network tags, and Cloud NAT so private VMs can reach the internet.
days.deliverable: Network diagram, firewall rules and connectivity results
checks: From a private VM, curl a public site
From the internet, reach the private VM
Reach the app VM from a VM without the web tag

days.topic: Load Balancing and Managed Instance Groups
days.lab_task: Put a managed instance group of web servers behind a global HTTP load balancer with autoscaling and autohealing, then delete an instance and watch it return.
days.deliverable: Load balancer and group configuration with scaling history
checks: Refresh the load balancer IP several times
Responses come from more than one instance
Break the health check on one VM
objectives: Scale and heal VM groups automatically

days.topic: Cloud SQL Managed Databases
days.lab_task: Create a PostgreSQL Cloud SQL instance with private IP, connect from the app VM, create a table, and restore a point-in-time clone.
days.deliverable: Instance configuration, connection test and restore evidence
checks: Connect from your laptop without the proxy
Fails because the instance has no public IP
Clone to a time before a row was deleted

days.topic: Firestore and Bigtable NoSQL
subtopics: When to choose Firestore, Bigtable or Cloud SQL
days.lab_task: Store orders in Firestore with a composite index for customer and date queries, and design a Bigtable row key for time-series sensor data with a sample query.
days.deliverable: Data models, index definition and query results
checks: Query one customer's orders by date
Correct orders return using the index
Run the query before creating the index
Read the Bigtable row key design
Avoids hotspots and supports the query

days.topic: Cloud DNS and Cloud CDN
subtopics: Cloud CDN with the load balancer
days.lab_task: Create a private DNS zone for internal services, enable Cloud CDN with a managed certificate on the load balancer, and invalidate a cached file after an update.
days.deliverable: DNS configuration, CDN settings and cache test results
checks: Resolve an internal name from a VM
Second response is a cache hit

days.topic: Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging
days.lab_task: Install the Ops Agent on the web servers, build a dashboard, add an uptime check, and alert by email when CPU stays above 70% for 5 minutes.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, alert policy and the received alert
checks: Run a CPU stress test for 6 minutes
Find who deleted a test bucket
Admin Activity audit log shows the user

days.topic: gcloud CLI and Scripting
subtopics: gcloud components and alpha or beta commands
days.lab_task: Write a script that lists running VMs with their zone and machine type and stops those labelled env=dev, using service account impersonation instead of keys.
days.deliverable: Script, output and before and after VM states
checks: Search the environment for key files

days.topic: Cloud Run Serverless Containers
subtopics: Scaling to zero and minimum instances
days.lab_task: Deploy a container to Cloud Run with a secret from Secret Manager, release a second revision with 20% of traffic, and run a scheduled Cloud Run job.
days.deliverable: Service and job configuration with traffic split evidence
objectives: Run containers serverlessly on Cloud Run

days.topic: Cloud Functions and Eventarc
days.lab_task: Write a function triggered by uploads to a bucket that records file name, size and time in Firestore, with retries and idempotent writes.
days.deliverable: Function code, trigger configuration and Firestore documents for three uploads
checks: Function errors are visible in logs

days.topic: Pub/Sub Messaging
days.lab_task: Publish order events to a topic with a push subscription to a Cloud Run service and a pull subscription for reporting, with a dead-letter topic for failures.
days.deliverable: Topic and subscription configuration with delivery evidence
checks: Publish an event the service rejects
Moves to the dead-letter topic after max attempts
Participant explains redelivery of slow messages

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code on Google Cloud
days.lab_task: Recreate the VPC, Cloud Run service and Cloud SQL instance in Terraform with remote state in Cloud Storage, then change a setting through a plan and apply.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, plan and apply outputs
checks: Run terraform plan with no changes
Change the Cloud Run memory and plan

days.topic: Containers on Google Cloud: Artifact Registry and GKE Autopilot
subtopics: Exposing services with a load balancer
days.lab_task: Build an image with Cloud Build into Artifact Registry, deploy it to a GKE Autopilot cluster with Workload Identity reading Cloud Storage, and expose it.
days.deliverable: Build configuration, Kubernetes manifests and access test results
checks: Read the bucket from the pod
Vulnerabilities are listed in Artifact Registry
objectives: Grant pods Google Cloud access without keys

days.topic: Security Basics: Secret Manager, Cloud KMS and Security Command Center
subtopics: Encryption at rest and in transit
days.lab_task: Move the database password to Secret Manager, encrypt a bucket with a customer-managed key, apply a policy that blocks external VM IPs, and fix two Security Command Center findings.
days.deliverable: Configuration evidence and before and after findings
checks: Create a VM with an external IP
Search the app configuration for the password

days.topic: Cost Management and the Google Cloud Architecture Framework
subtopics: Billing reports and export to BigQuery
Recommender for idle and oversized resources
days.lab_task: Export billing to BigQuery, find the three most expensive resources by label, apply two Recommender suggestions, and review the course app against the Architecture Framework.
days.deliverable: Billing query results, savings proposals and the review summary
checks: Query billing by the project label
Includes current cost, change and saving
At least three with an improvement each
objectives: Track and reduce Google Cloud costs
Review a workload against best practices

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Highly Available Web Application on Google Cloud
subtopics: Cloud Run or managed instance group design
days.lab_task: Deploy a two-tier web application with Cloud Run or a managed instance group, a private Cloud SQL database, static files on Cloud CDN, alerts and a budget, then present it.
days.deliverable: Architecture diagram, deployed application, monitoring dashboard, monthly cost estimate and a 10-minute demo
checks: Release a new revision during the demo
Try to reach the database from the internet
Pricing calculator estimate matches the design
objectives: Design and deploy a highly available web application
Apply IAM, networking, security and monitoring together
Present an architecture with its cost

intermediate.summary: For participants who have used core Google Cloud services. Covers organisation design, shared VPC, Terraform at scale, GKE, data and analytics services, CI/CD with Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy, and operations.
prerequisites: Has deployed Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, VPC, Cloud SQL and Cloud Run
Comfortable with gcloud and IAM roles
Basic Linux command line, Git and Docker
outcomes: Design organisation, folder, project and shared VPC structures
Build infrastructure with Terraform modules for Google Cloud
Run workloads on GKE and data pipelines with BigQuery, Dataflow and Pub/Sub
Deliver workloads with Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy, with observability and cost controls

days.topic: Organisation Design: Folders, Projects and Organisation Policies
subtopics: Folder strategy by environment and business unit
days.lab_task: Design a folder structure for three business units, create projects with a project factory in Terraform, and apply organisation policies restricting regions and service account keys.
days.deliverable: Hierarchy diagram, project factory code and policy test results
checks: Create a resource in a disallowed region
Create a new project from the factory
Has the baseline APIs, IAM and labels

days.topic: Shared VPC, Peering and Private Service Connect
subtopics: Shared VPC host and service projects
Hybrid connectivity: Cloud VPN and Interconnect
days.lab_task: Set up a shared VPC for two service projects, publish an internal service through Private Service Connect, and connect a simulated on-premises network with HA VPN.
days.deliverable: Network design, configuration and connectivity results
checks: From a service project VM, reach the shared subnet
Consume the published service through its endpoint
Traffic continues over the second tunnel

days.topic: Terraform Modules for Google Cloud
subtopics: Writing project, network and service modules
Policy checks with gcloud terraform vet
days.lab_task: Build modules for a project, network and Cloud Run service, deploy dev and prod with impersonated service accounts, and block a policy-breaking plan with terraform vet.
days.deliverable: Module code, environment configurations and pipeline results
checks: Search the repository for key files
objectives: Build Google Cloud infrastructure with modules

days.topic: GKE Standard Clusters in Depth
days.lab_task: Create a private regional GKE cluster with two node pools, deploy an app through the Gateway API with a managed certificate, and upgrade it through its release channel.
days.deliverable: Cluster configuration, manifests and upgrade record
checks: Open the app through the gateway
Reach the control plane from the internet
Blocked by the private cluster setup
objectives: Expose apps with the Gateway API

days.topic: Data Warehousing with BigQuery
days.lab_task: Load sales data into partitioned and clustered tables, write reporting queries, compare bytes scanned with and without partitioning, and share an authorised view.
days.deliverable: Table definitions, queries, cost comparison and the authorised view
checks: Run the monthly report on the partitioned table
Scans far fewer bytes than the unpartitioned one
Query the authorised view as an analyst
Run a query over the cost cap
objectives: Model and load data in BigQuery

days.topic: Data Pipelines with Dataflow and Pub/Sub
days.lab_task: Build a streaming pipeline from Pub/Sub to BigQuery that computes per-minute order totals, sends malformed messages to a dead-letter table, and handles late events.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, job graph and results for a 10-minute replay
checks: Per-minute totals match the expected values
They land in the dead-letter table
Send late events within the allowed lateness

days.topic: Orchestration with Cloud Composer and Workflows
subtopics: When to use Composer or Workflows
days.lab_task: Write an Airflow DAG that loads daily files to BigQuery and runs quality checks, and a Workflow that calls two Cloud Run services with retries.
days.deliverable: DAG, Workflow definition and run histories
checks: Run the DAG for one day
DAG fails at the check and alerts
Make one service fail twice then succeed

days.topic: CI/CD with Cloud Build and Cloud Deploy
subtopics: Canary deployments to Cloud Run and GKE
days.lab_task: Create a pipeline that builds and scans an image, deploys to dev, promotes to prod with approval as a 25% canary, and rolls back a bad release.
days.deliverable: Build and delivery configuration with release history
checks: Image is built and deployed to dev

days.topic: Identity for Workloads and Pipelines
subtopics: Workload Identity Federation for external systems
GitHub Actions to Google Cloud without keys
days.lab_task: Let a GitHub Actions workflow deploy to Cloud Run through Workload Identity Federation, add an IAM Condition that limits a role to working hours, and remove unused permissions.
days.deliverable: Federation configuration, workflow run and IAM changes
checks: Use the conditioned role outside working hours

days.topic: Application Security: Cloud Armor, IAP and VPC Service Controls
days.lab_task: Protect the public app with Cloud Armor WAF rules and rate limits, put an internal admin app behind IAP, and add a service perimeter around the data projects.
days.deliverable: Security policies, IAP settings and perimeter test results
checks: Send a SQL injection test string
Open the admin app without the right group
Copy data from the perimeter to an outside bucket
objectives: Protect web apps with Cloud Armor

days.topic: Observability: Cloud Trace, Profiler and Managed Prometheus
subtopics: Google Cloud Managed Service for Prometheus
days.lab_task: Instrument the services with OpenTelemetry, find a slow request in Cloud Trace, find a CPU hotspot with Cloud Profiler, and define an SLO with a burn-rate alert.
days.deliverable: Trace and profile screenshots, SLO definition and alert

days.topic: Backup, Disaster Recovery and Multi-Region Design
days.lab_task: Set RPO and RTO for the app, add a cross-region Cloud SQL replica and a second Cloud Run region behind the global load balancer, and run a timed failover test.
days.deliverable: DR plan, configuration and failover timeline
checks: Load balancer sends traffic to the second region
App writes to the promoted database
Compare measured recovery with the RTO
Within target or the gap is explained

days.topic: Operations: OS Config, Patching and Fleet Management
days.lab_task: Patch all dev VMs with a scheduled patch job, enforce an OS policy that keeps the web server installed, and write a function that restarts unhealthy VMs from an alert.
days.deliverable: Patch job report, OS policy and automated remediation evidence
checks: Open patch compliance after the window
Function restarts it from the alert

days.topic: Cost Optimisation for Running Workloads on Google Cloud
subtopics: Cloud Run minimum instances and concurrency
days.lab_task: Reduce the monthly cost of the course workload by at least 30% with right-sizing, Spot VMs, Cloud Run tuning, Autoclass and BigQuery settings, measuring before and after.
days.deliverable: Cost analysis with before and after estimates and the changes made
checks: Reduction of at least 30% or a documented reason
Lower after the change, with figures
objectives: Measure cost per unit of work
Apply compute, serverless, storage and analytics savings

days.topic: Migrating Workloads to Google Cloud
subtopics: Moving containers to GKE or Cloud Run
days.lab_task: Assess a simulated on-premises environment, migrate a MySQL database with continuous replication to Cloud SQL, and cut over with less than 5 minutes of write downtime.
days.deliverable: Assessment, migration job configuration and cut-over timeline
checks: Compare row counts after the initial load
Write rows to the source during replication
Rows appear in Cloud SQL within a minute

days.topic: Vertex AI and Generative AI Integration
days.lab_task: Add a question-answering feature to the web app with Gemini on Vertex AI grounded on the course FAQs through Vertex AI Search, called from Cloud Run with a service account.
days.deliverable: Feature code, configuration and answers for 10 test questions
checks: Answers cite the correct FAQ entries
Ask a question outside the FAQs
App says it does not know instead of inventing an answer
No API keys stored; service account identity used
objectives: Ground answers with Vertex AI Search

days.topic: Governance: Policy as Code, Asset Inventory and Compliance
days.lab_task: Write a custom organisation policy constraint, query Asset Inventory for unlabelled resources across projects, and produce a compliance report for leadership.
days.deliverable: Constraint definition, asset queries and the compliance report
checks: Create a resource breaking the custom constraint
Shows compliance by project with owners

days.topic: Hybrid and Multi-Cloud with GKE Enterprise
days.lab_task: Register two clusters in a fleet, manage their configuration with Config Sync from Git, enforce a policy with Policy Controller, and reach both through the Connect gateway.
days.deliverable: Fleet configuration, Git repository and policy test results
checks: Run kubectl through the Connect gateway
Works without direct cluster network access
objectives: Apply configuration and policy from Git
Access clusters through the Connect gateway

days.topic: Comparing Google Cloud with AWS and Azure
subtopics: Service mapping across the three clouds
Choosing a cloud for a workload
days.lab_task: Deploy the same container web service on Cloud Run and one other cloud's serverless container service with Terraform, and compare setup effort, cost and operations.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, service mapping table and a one-page comparison
checks: Same service responds on both clouds
Uses the same assumptions for both
Justified with at least three criteria
objectives: Map services between Google Cloud and other clouds

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Data-Driven Application Platform on Google Cloud
subtopics: Organisation, shared VPC and Terraform modules
Security controls and CI/CD with canary release
days.lab_task: Build an order platform that streams events through Pub/Sub and Dataflow into BigQuery dashboards, with secured services, infrastructure as code and a canary pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, architecture diagram, dashboards, cost estimate and a 15-minute demo
checks: They appear in the BigQuery report within a few minutes
objectives: Design and build a data-driven platform end to end
Combine infrastructure as code, data, security and delivery

advanced.summary: For experienced Google Cloud engineers. Covers enterprise foundations, global architecture, security at scale, platform engineering, large-scale data and AI platforms, FinOps, SRE and architecture reviews.
prerequisites: Two or more years building and operating workloads on Google Cloud
Has used Terraform, CI/CD and GKE or Cloud Run in production
Associate Cloud Engineer level knowledge or equivalent experience
outcomes: Design enterprise foundations and global architectures on Google Cloud
Run security, compliance and data protection at scale
Build platforms and data or AI platforms that teams can self-serve
Lead architecture reviews and justify trade-offs with evidence

days.topic: Enterprise Landing Zone Blueprint Implementation
subtopics: Bootstrap, organisation, environments and networks stages
Hub-and-spoke or shared VPC per environment
days.lab_task: Deploy the foundation stages for a company with three business units using Terraform pipelines, and vend a new application project that inherits all baselines.
days.deliverable: Foundation repositories, pipeline runs and a vended project
checks: Vend a project through the pipeline
Project has networking, logging and policies
Change flows through review and pipeline only
Deploy a non-compliant resource in the new project

days.topic: Global Architecture: Multi-Region Active-Active on Google Cloud
subtopics: When active-active is worth the cost
Regional Cloud Run and GKE deployments
days.lab_task: Build an active-active API in two regions on Cloud Spanner behind the global load balancer, simulate losing one region, and measure read and write impact.
days.deliverable: Decision record, deployment and the failure test report
checks: Write the same record from both regions
Traffic moves within the stated time
Extra cost compared with one region is quantified
objectives: Use Spanner for consistent global data

days.topic: Resilience Engineering and Chaos Testing on Google Cloud
subtopics: Chaos experiments on GKE and Compute Engine
days.lab_task: Run three chaos experiments (zone loss, dependency latency, Pub/Sub backlog) against the course platform, and fix one weakness each experiment reveals.
days.deliverable: Experiment plans, results and resilience improvements
checks: Service stays within its error budget
Timeouts and fallbacks behave as designed

days.topic: Security at Scale: Security Command Center, Chronicle and Response
subtopics: Security Command Center Premium or Enterprise
days.lab_task: Automate response to a simulated compromised VM: isolate it with firewall rules, snapshot its disk for forensics, disable its service account and open a ticket with the evidence.
days.deliverable: Response automation, runbook and incident timeline
checks: Snapshot exists and is labelled with the finding ID

days.topic: Data Protection: Cloud KMS, Confidential Computing and Sensitive Data Protection
subtopics: Sensitive Data Protection discovery and de-identification
days.lab_task: Apply CMEK to storage, BigQuery and Cloud SQL for confidential data, discover and de-identify personal data in BigQuery, and prove that disabling a key blocks access.
days.deliverable: Encryption design, de-identification results and access test results
checks: Data in the protected services becomes unreadable until re-enabled
objectives: Design key management for regulated data

days.topic: Zero-Trust Access with BeyondCorp and VPC Service Controls
subtopics: Access levels from device and location
Perimeter bridges and ingress or egress rules
days.lab_task: Replace VPN access to internal tools with context-aware IAP, design perimeters for three data projects in dry-run then enforce mode, and allow one approved data flow.
days.deliverable: Access design, perimeter configuration and test matrix
checks: Access an internal tool from an unmanaged device
Move data across the perimeter without a rule
objectives: Roll out perimeters safely with dry-run

days.topic: Platform Engineering on Google Cloud
subtopics: Golden paths for Cloud Run and GKE
Self-service with Config Connector or Terraform
days.lab_task: Build a golden path that creates a service with repository, Cloud Deploy pipeline, Cloud Run service, monitoring and SLOs in one self-service request.
days.deliverable: Template code, a service created from it and a platform scorecard
checks: Create a service from the template
Repository, pipeline, service and SLO dashboard exist
objectives: Design internal platforms around golden paths

days.topic: GKE at Scale: Fleets, Multi-Tenancy and Cost
days.lab_task: Run a multi-tenant fleet of two GKE clusters for three teams with team scopes, network policies and a multi-cluster gateway, and report cost per team.
days.deliverable: Fleet configuration, tenant policies and a cost allocation report
checks: Team A pod calls a Team B service
Multi-cluster gateway serves from the other

days.topic: Serverless and Event-Driven Architecture at Scale
subtopics: Cloud Run scaling limits and concurrency
days.lab_task: Load test the order platform to 3,000 events per second, find the first limit, and redesign with ordering keys, concurrency tuning and idempotency until it meets the latency target.
days.deliverable: Load test reports, limits found and redesign with results
checks: Run the load test before the redesign
objectives: Find and handle serverless scaling limits

days.topic: Enterprise Data Platform: BigQuery Lakehouse and Dataplex
subtopics: Dataplex lakes, zones and data quality
days.lab_task: Build a governed lakehouse with BigLake tables, Dataplex quality rules and policy tags on sensitive columns, then tune a slow reporting workload with reservations.
days.deliverable: Lakehouse design, governance configuration, quality results and tuning report
checks: Load data that breaks a quality rule
objectives: Apply fine-grained data access and quality

days.topic: Production AI Platforms on Vertex AI
subtopics: RAG with Vertex AI Search or vector search
Private endpoints and VPC Service Controls
days.lab_task: Build a RAG assistant over the course runbooks on Vertex AI with private access, safety settings, an evaluation set of 20 questions, and dashboards for tokens, latency and quality.
days.deliverable: Assistant code, safety configuration, evaluation results and dashboard
checks: Groundedness and correctness meet the stated thresholds
Call the endpoint from outside the perimeter
objectives: Build production RAG on Vertex AI

days.topic: FinOps Practice on Google Cloud
days.lab_task: Build a chargeback dashboard per business unit from the billing export, define a cost-per-order metric, and recommend a committed use discount purchase.
days.deliverable: Chargeback dashboard, unit cost metric and commitment recommendation
checks: Compare chargeback totals with the invoice

days.topic: Compliance Automation and Assured Workloads
days.lab_task: Create an Assured Workloads folder for a regulated workload, map 10 controls to policies and pipeline checks, automate remediation for two, and produce an evidence report.
days.deliverable: Assured Workloads configuration, control mapping, remediation code and evidence report
checks: Push a template that breaks a pipeline check
objectives: Run regulated workloads on Google Cloud

days.topic: Performance Engineering for Google Cloud Workloads
days.lab_task: Bring a slow API from 900 ms to under 200 ms p95 at the target load using Query Insights, Memorystore and connection tuning, documenting each change and its effect.
days.deliverable: Performance report with each change and its effect, and the final load test
checks: p95 under 200 ms at target load
Show the top query before and after
Hit a quota during the test
Participant identifies and plans for it

days.topic: Large-Scale Migration and Modernisation Strategy on Google Cloud
subtopics: Modernising to Cloud Run and GKE
days.lab_task: Produce a migration plan for a 60-application portfolio: classify each by strategy, plan three waves with dependencies, and write the business case for wave 1.
days.deliverable: Portfolio analysis, wave plan and business case
checks: No application moves before its dependencies
Includes costs, savings, risks and payback

days.topic: SRE Practice on Google Cloud
days.lab_task: Define SLOs for the order platform, set multi-window burn-rate alerts, and run a 60-minute incident simulation with assigned roles followed by a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: SLO definitions, alert policies, incident timeline and review
checks: Inject errors that burn 10% of the budget in an hour
Roles, decisions and updates are recorded
Root cause and at least three owned actions
objectives: Lead incidents and learn from them

days.topic: Hybrid and Distributed Cloud Strategy
subtopics: GKE Enterprise on-premises and on other clouds
days.lab_task: Evaluate a data-residency requirement for a provided client, prototype consistent policy and configuration across a cloud and an on-premises cluster, and recommend an approach.
days.deliverable: Prototype, evaluation and recommendation
checks: Apply one policy change in Git
Each data type has a location and reason
Uses cost, risk and operational evidence

days.topic: Infrastructure Governance at Scale with Terraform and Config Connector
days.lab_task: Manage the same Cloud SQL product through Terraform and Config Connector, compare the developer experience and governance, and set a standard for the organisation.
days.deliverable: Both implementations, comparison and the organisation standard
checks: Create the database with each tool
Break a policy with each tool
States when to use each tool and why

days.topic: Google Cloud Architecture Reviews and Trade-off Decisions
subtopics: Reference architectures in the Architecture Center
days.lab_task: Review another team's capstone design with the Architecture Framework, write two decision records for its biggest risks, and present recommendations.
days.deliverable: Review report, two decision records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Each high risk has evidence and a recommendation
Options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Participant defends it with cost and risk evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Global Regulated Platform on Google Cloud
subtopics: Security, data protection and compliance evidence
days.lab_task: Design and build a global platform for a regulated client, including foundations, workloads, data protection, compliance automation, recovery and a cost model, then defend it to a review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, working deployment, security and recovery test evidence, cost model and a 20-minute review presentation
checks: Recovery meets the stated RTO and RPO
Security Command Center and policy reports
Monthly cost is broken down and reconciles with the pricing calculator
objectives: Design an enterprise-grade Google Cloud platform end to end
Prove reliability, security and cost with evidence
Defend architecture decisions to a review board
